title: Cincinnati: tailoring night school and Wes Helvey's band
summary: He goes to Cincinnati, studies tailoring at night, works at a motor company and plays with Wesley Helvey's band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: That's the way I started professionally. My brother wouldn't let me finish tailoring ...
You don't have to hold it. We've got mikes all around.

OK. So, I went to Cincinnati and while I was there I went to night school to finish tailoring and I worked in Wesley Helvey's band ... good band. he had a heck of a good band, still couldn't read the music. Wesley, how do you spell that last name?
... played in his band a couple of nights a week, Did a whole lot of work go to night school for tailoring and worked at the Giant Motor Company in the morning.
Were all of these bands your friends around Atlanta?
